## Design note

A stage car with number plates. Short gearing, a hard-hitting turbo and permanent four-wheel drive with locking diffs at both ends make it the fastest thing in the roster out of a slow corner, in the wet, or over a kerb. Long-travel suspension soaks up broken city roads that unsettle the low sports cars. It understeers on a trailing throttle; brake late, flick it, and drive it out on the power.

## How this car breaks

Late-90s HSS cell, no stronger than any saloon of its era. The big front-mounted intercooler and radiator sit right behind a thin bumper, so nose hits overheat it early. The centre and rear diffs and the prop shaft run under the floor — heavy sill or kerb strikes can take out drive to the rear. The aluminium hood folds rather than dents.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for late-90s rally-homologation AWD 2.0 T saloons
- owner dyno averages for 2.0 L turbo I4s at the period power cap
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, opposed-piston caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

## Engine

2.0 L DOHC 16-valve I4, single turbo, intercooled, transverse. Class-typical late-90s rally-homologation 2.0 T (~103 kW/L, 206 kW at 6500 rpm, ~373 N·m at 3000) per manufacturer spec-class data and owner dynos; the period's voluntary power cap shows as the flat top end.

## Drivetrain

5-speed close-ratio manual, permanent AWD with a fixed 45/55 centre split (viscous-locked centre diff), helical-style front LSD (modelled as clutch LSD), clutch-type rear LSD. Layout **AWD, 45 % front**; front diff: clutch LSD, preload 30 N·m, power ramp 0.25, coast ramp 0.10; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 80 N·m, power ramp 0.50, coast ramp 0.30. Clutch capacity 1.45 × peak torque = 540 N·m. Shift time 0.38 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2.79 | 12.64 | 64 |
| 2 | 1.95 | 8.83 | 92 |
| 3 | 1.41 | 6.39 | 127 |
| 4 | 1.03 | 4.67 | 174 |
| 5 | 0.76 | 3.44 | 236 |

Final drive 4.53, reverse 3.42. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.308 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 394 kg | 1.70 Hz | 44900 N/m | 2520 N·s/m | 3780 N·s/m | 0.17 m |
| Rear | 255 kg | 1.80 Hz | 32700 N/m | 1730 N·s/m | 2600 N·s/m | 0.18 m |

Round 12b ride rule (A): the file carries the derived dampers × 1.2 bump / × 1.6 rebound (rebound ≈ 2 × bump), after any tunes below: **3020 / 6050 N·s/m F, 2080 / 4160 N·s/m R** (bump / rebound).

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 2.5°/g with 55% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.404 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 125926 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 51237 F / 36734 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **7900 F / 8900 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 2.5°/g, front share 55%. Bump stops 160000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.8° F / -1.2° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 4.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 320 mm disc, pistons per side 40 mm + 40 mm → A = 25.1 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 135 mm, pad μ = 0.42: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.42·100 bar·25.1 cm²·0.135 m = **2850 N·m**
- Rear: 300 mm disc, pistons per side 36 mm → A = 10.2 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 125 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·10.2 cm²·0.125 m = **1018 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1672 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.70×), rear needs 420 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.43×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 716 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.588** → delivered 2850 N·m front / 715 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1260 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 13.5:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 11.0 m → outer-front path radius 5.39 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.01 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.559 rad (32.0°)** (outer 27.8°, inner 37.6° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.60). Rack speed 1.7 rad/s.
